create_compiler: create a compiler adaptor from a CompilationConfig, returning InductorAdaptor, EagerAdaptor, or custom backend
run_vllm_backend: run the VllmBackend to compile a torch FX graph into a piecewise callable with caching and CUDA graph support
split_graph: split a torch FX graph module into piecewise subgraphs based on configurable splitting ops
create_cudagraph_wrapper: create a CUDA graph wrapper around a piecewise backend for dynamic input tensor copying
manage_compilation_cache: manage compilation cache by loading, storing, and hashing compiled graphs across runtime shapes
